title: Approvals
description: Every request from the approvals engine: discounts, credit limits, payout runs, factory prices, bank accounts and settings.
inboxEmptyBody: New requests that need your decision appear here.
payloadHint: Frozen when the request was made; it does not change if the source does.
commentHint: The requester and auditors will see this.

confirm.description: {summary} — your decision is recorded with your name and cannot be changed.

blockers.ownRequest: You made this request, so someone else must decide it.
blockers.alreadyActed: You approved an earlier step; the next step must be someone else.

belowFloorBody: This discount takes the margin below the floor; only C-Level may approve it.

delegations.title: Delegations
delegations.explain: While you are away, a delegate can approve for you within the dates you set — recorded as acting on your behalf.
delegations.createDescription: A delegate can never approve their own requests.
delegations.endAfterStart: The end must be after the start

waitingForOtherBody: Your account cannot decide this step; the approver has been notified. Due

bulk.done: Approved {count, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}}
bulk.someFailed: {count, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}} could not be approved

matrix.body: Who approves what, step by step. A change is a new version another Superadmin approves; the version in force is never edited.
matrix.autoApprove: Requests up to {amount} are approved without the second approval

propose.title: Propose a version of {policy}
propose.body: Enter every step in order. Another Superadmin approves it; once approved it applies from its date. The expiry rule carries over from the version in force.

errors.name: Name step {n}.
errors.condition: Step {n}'s condition must be a JSON object.
errors.backDated: The effective date cannot be in the past.
errors.reason: Give a reason (3 characters or more).
errors.autoApprove: The auto-approve amount must be money, e.g. 1000.00
errors.autoApproveNeedsAmount: An auto-approve amount needs a step with an amount condition

propose.done: Proposal sent — a Superadmin approves it
propose.name: Step {n} name
propose.conditionHint: A JSON object with field, op (lte, gte, eq …) and value, or several joined by all / any; empty = always
propose.effectiveHint: Approved after this date, it applies from the approval
propose.autoApproveHint: Only for policies with an amount condition; Superadmin only; empty = none
propose.autoApproveReadOnly: The auto-approve amount in force is carried over (only a Superadmin changes it)

solo.title: Solo-owner mode
solo.explain: While on, a Superadmin may approve their own request with a typed reason; it is labelled "Self-approved" and listed in a daily digest to Superadmins. It never applies to a step someone else can approve.
solo.activeUntil: A Superadmin may approve their own requests (with a typed reason) until {date} — except steps another approver can decide
solo.turnOnBody: While on, a Superadmin may approve their own requests one by one with a reason; each is recorded and listed in the daily digest. It turns itself off at expiry.
solo.turnOffBody: Once off, nobody approves their own request; another approver must decide.
solo.expiresHint: Leave empty for {days} days from now (at most {days} days)
solo.expiresHintNoMax: Leave empty to use the configured maximum

errors.reason: Give a reason of at least 3 characters

selfApprove.calloutTitle: Your request — you can self-approve it in solo-owner mode
selfApprove.calloutBody: Type a reason; the approval is labelled "Self-approved" and listed in the daily digest to Superadmins. If someone else can approve this step, self-approval is refused.
selfApprove.reasonHint: At least {min} characters, stored with the approval

autoApproved.title: Auto-approved
autoApproved.body: This request's amount is within the policy's auto-approve amount, so no second approval was needed (recorded with the reason "below threshold").
